subject: FastLedger onboarding: tax docs, bank info & PO steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Machado <sofia@fastledger.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: FastLedger onboarding: tax docs, bank info & PO steps

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get FastLedger set up so we can issue a PO and start the pilot. To keep procurement moving, can you please provide the following items by end of next week: 

- Completed tax form: W-9 (US) or W-8BEN-E (if FastLedger is non-US). If you have an EU VAT registration, please attach that as well.
- Legal company name exactly as you want it on the PO and W-9/W-8.
- Bank wiring details or ACH instructions (we redact account numbers in shared drives).
- Point of contact for invoices and AP email.

I attached our short vendor checklist to show what procurement needs (see "Redwood_Vendor_Checklist_2026-08.pdf"). Once we have W-9/W-8 + bank info, finance will issue the PO (target: within 3 business days).

Quick logistics: our PO workflows require a legal name match on the tax form; if the name on the W-9 differs from your vendor portal name, please call that out in your response.

Thanks — copying Karthik (procurement) and Dev (finance) in case they have follow-ups.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Checklist_2026-08.pdf (application/pdf, 95 KB)

From: Sofia Machado <sofia@fastledger.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@fastledger.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: FastLedger onboarding: tax docs, bank info & PO steps

Hi Neha — thanks for the checklist and the clear timeline. Attaching our completed W-9 and a redacted bank details PDF for PO setup. FastLedger is a US entity (FastLedger Payments, Inc.) so W-9 is the right form.

A few notes:
- Legal name on W-9: FastLedger Payments, Inc.
- AP email: accounts-payable@fastledger.com
- We typically require net-45 on new pilot agreements; is Redwood able to approve net-30 for the initial PO? If not, we can accept net-45 and discuss later.

Attached: FastLedger_W9_2026.pdf, FastLedger_BankDetails_redacted.pdf

Let me know if you need a signed vendor agreement — otherwise happy to receive the PO and invoice per the bank details.

Best,
Sofia Machado
Head of Finance Operations
FastLedger Payments
sofia@fastledger.com
Attachments: FastLedger_W9_2026.pdf (application/pdf, 110 KB), FastLedger_BankDetails_redacted.pdf (application/pdf, 48 KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Machado <sofia@fastledger.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FastLedger onboarding: tax docs, bank info & PO steps

Hi Sofia — received, thank you. I reviewed the W-9 and the legal name matches what we need (FastLedger Payments, Inc.). A couple quick points so we can finalize the PO this week: 

- Finance asks whether FastLedger will accept net-30 for the pilot PO. Dev, can we approve net-30 for this vendor for the pilot?
- Can you confirm whether invoicing currency will be USD (expected) or EUR? If EUR, we’ll need your VAT registration docs.
- For our records, could you also complete the short bank form (I attached the one-line "Vendor_Wiring_Instructions_Form"). You can redact full account numbers in the thread preview; procurement will request the secure form if needed.

I opened a HubSpot record and linked it in the thread for our sales/ops team: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/FL-7890. If you prefer a signed contract before the PO, we can route a quick DocuSign (link below) — otherwise we will issue the PO and attach Redwood's standard terms.

Thanks again — copying Laura from legal to flag any billing/terms notes.

Cheers,
Neha
Attachment: Vendor_Wiring_Instructions_Form.pdf (application/pdf, 12 KB)
Related link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC123def
